errors.evidence: The description states the time range is from Q1 2023 to Q4 2025, but the x-axis clearly shows monthly data (using Roman numerals) from January 2023 to April 2025.

errors.text_span: като всяка година е разделена на дванадесет месеца, започвайки от януари (I) до декември (XII)
errors.evidence: This statement is an over-generalization because the year 2025 is not fully represented; the data only extends to month IV (April).

errors.text_span: пада до минимум 80,0% в XII 2023 г.
errors.evidence: The minimum value of the solid line in December 2023 is approximately 78.0%, not 80.0%. The stated value is an inaccurate approximation.
The maximum value of the solid line is in March 2024, but the value is approximately 113.5%, which is visibly below the 115.0 grid line.
In May 2024 (V 2024), the value of the solid line is approximately 102.5%, not 105.0%. The value of 105.0% is reached in April 2024 (IV 2024).
The final value of the solid line in April 2025 is approximately 93.0%, making 90.0% an inaccurate underestimation.

errors.text_span: Линията е съпроводена с уравнение на пето степен: y = 3E-05x⁵ - 0,0016x⁴ + 0,0202x³ + 0,2087x² - 3,2374x + 97,315 и коефициент на детерминация R² = 0,5126.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly attributes the polynomial equation and R² value to the solid data line. These elements describe the dotted trend line.
